2608.00419.title: Unleashing the Potential of Large Language Models: A Blueprint for Real-Time, Enterprise-Ready Deployments
2608.00419.paper_summary: Large language models deployed in real-time, regulated settings face knowledge staleness, catastrophic forgetting, hallucination, and weak feedback loops. We present a unified, pattern-driven LLMOps architecture integrating real-time data ingestion, continual learning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and human-in-the-loop feedback into a single operational pipeline. Four contributions map to established software design patterns: an adaptive ingestion pattern orchestrator (AIPO) evaluated with FreshStreamBench; STAR+FAR continual learning with sparse temporal adapter routing and freshness-aware replay; SAGE, an SLO-aware adaptive retrieval policy predicting a per-query passage budget to meet tail-latency targets; and an automated feedback-driven convergence stage with RLHF triggers. The result reduces latency-cost-accuracy trade-offs while supporting auditability and rollback for high-risk sectors such as health care and finance.
2608.00419.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型在實時、受規範的環境中部署時面臨知識過時、災難性遺忘、幻覺和弱反饋迴路的問題。<lb/>我們提出了一個統一的、以模式驅動的LLMOps架構，將實時數據攝取、持續學習、檢索增強生成（RAG）和人類參與的反饋整合到一個單一的操作管道中。<lb/>四個貢獻對應於已建立的軟體設計模式：一個適應性攝取模式協調器（AIPO），使用FreshStreamBench進行評估；STAR+FAR持續學習，結合稀疏時間適配器路由和新鮮度感知重播；SAGE，一個SLO感知的適應性檢索策略，預測每次查詢的段落預算，以滿足尾延遲目標；以及一個自動化的反饋驅動收斂階段，配備RLHF觸發器。<lb/>結果減少了延遲、成本和準確性之間的權衡，同時支持高風險領域如醫療保健和金融的可審計性和回滾功能。
